Actx0 is the memory layer your agents are missing — a drop-in infrastructure that stores what matters, retrieves it in milliseconds, and keeps working across sessions, agents, and apps. Built for production teams who care about latency, cost, and control.

posts.name: OneCLI

posts.name: Project SKY

Whether you need instant screen analysis with circle-style smart selection, automated desktop workflows, or voice-driven task management, SKY understands what you're working on across all your applications without breaking your focus.

posts.name: ShogunAI

Reading is automatic. Sending always waits for your approval, macOS today.

posts.name: ClubManager
posts.tagline: Spend less time managing. More time on football.
posts.description: ClubManager is the first all-in-one club management platform specifically designed for football clubs. It aims to manage every part of a football club from a single platform and is one of the first solutions offering AI-assisted administration. Custom fields and programmable extensions make ClubManager fully customisable and suitable for any size.

posts.name: Apiboo
posts.tagline: API client, database, chat, docs and vault in one local app
posts.description: One native desktop app for the tools developers switch between: a REST and GraphQL client, a database manager for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite, an SSH terminal and SFTP, docs, kanban boards, team chat and an end-to-end encrypted vault. Imports your Postman, Insomnia, Bruno and OpenAPI collections in one click, and the AI assistant runs on your own API key. Everything works offline on your machine, free and without an account. Cloud sync, vault sync and shared team workspaces are the paid part.

posts.name: Growth War Room
posts.tagline: Understand your market before you build it
posts.description: A multi-agent AI growth system for market truth, GTM strategy, risks, and CMO decisions. We hear all the time that distribution is the what makes or breaks the product. Now with the help of GTM agents you would understand your market before you built it.

posts.name: TravelAppBuilder
posts.tagline: Build your personal travel guide and learn from history
posts.description: Did you know travelers spend an average of 19 hours researching and planning a holiday? TravelAppBuilder does the heavy lifting for you. Build your personal travel app from your bookings in minutes, with day planning, travel documents, weather, currency tools, scam alerts and emergency info. Discover local places, stories and history with your personal travel guide plus local events happening at your destination on that specific day. Just book your trip, and enjoy it without hours of research

posts.name: RapidStarter
posts.tagline: CRM that updates itself
posts.description: Stop losing deals in forgotten follow-ups. RapidStarter turns Microsoft 365 email and calendar activity into follow-ups, contacts, and pipeline for small teams.

posts.name: Fifteen
posts.tagline: Buy your fifteen minutes of fame. Then watch it expire.
posts.description: Everyone buys attention. Almost nobody shows the price. On Fifteen the price is the product. Every listing carries what it paid, its click count, and its cost per click, in public. The Line ranks by amount paid, from $10, and each position fades 5% a day, so nobody owns the top forever. Today's Fifteen auctions one full day to one winner, useful if you have a launch date: your card is authorized and charged only if you still lead at midnight. No ads, no algorithm, no revenue share, no login.

posts.name: Statin
posts.tagline: Are bots and fake signups ruining your app analytics?
posts.description: Most IP lookup and threat detection tools give you a simple "yes" or "no." But modern traffic isn't binary residential proxies, subtle scraper bots, and privacy VPNs require a far more nuanced approach.Traffic.statin.io provides real-time, intelligent traffic analysis with built-in risk scoring so you can make smarter security decisions without ruining the experience for legitimate users. Advanced Bot & Proxy Detection: Instantly spot bots, proxies, VPNs, Tor nodes, and hosting data centers.

posts.name: InvoiceAbroad
posts.tagline: Free cross-border invoices with VAT wording built in
posts.description: A free invoice generator for freelancers with international clients. Pick the currency and tax treatment, add reverse-charge or outside-scope wording automatically, and download a clean PDF. No signup, no watermark, and nothing is sent to a server.

posts.name: Is It Down Bro?
posts.tagline: Check If Any Website or App Is Down
posts.description: Is It Down Bro? Check current status of any Website or App, Error received? Server Down? Slow? Check what is going on. Check if your favorite website is down.

posts.name: YouExtrac
posts.tagline: Stop screenshotting YouTube descriptions to find song names
posts.description: YouExtrac extracts songs from long YouTube playlists and video descriptions into clean track lists with direct YouTube and Spotify links.

posts.name: Kosmos
posts.tagline: IA que automatiza intimações e processos jurídicos
posts.description: O Kosmos lê intimações, identifica prazos, cria tarefas no Kanban e conecta clientes, documentos, assinaturas e financeiro. Teste grátis por 10 dias.

posts.name: Imagild
posts.tagline: Curated AI photo styles that understand your image
posts.description: Imagild is an AI photo style marketplace and editor built around curated photo Skills, not one-click filters. Upload a real photo, explore authentic before-and-after examples, and choose from distinctive aesthetic directions including enamel, ink, zine, textile, collage, cinematic color, and retro print. Each Skill considers the image before transforming it, while originals and results remain private by default. Free accounts can create one image every day.

posts.name: OpenPlan
posts.tagline: Waze for AI agents. Plan, track, and learn from projects.
posts.description: An MCP server that helps AI agents plan, track, and learn from software projects.

posts.name: uplo
posts.tagline: Client delivery and approvals for freelancers
posts.description: Uplo introduces a timeline‑based delivery and approval workflow built specifically for freelancers and studios. Instead of sending clients multiple links, files, and messages across email, cloud storage, and chat apps, Uplo gives clients a single clean timeline where every update, preview, and final file is organised automatically. Clients can view the timeline and files without needing an Uplo account. Final deliveries are released automatically after invoices are paid.

posts.name: Netsight - WiFi Tools
posts.tagline: What's on your WiFi?
posts.description: Netsight gives you a complete, visual view of your local network. Instantly discover every connected device, identify what it is using local AI analysis, see where it sits in your network topology, and check which ports are open. It also includes a powerful toolkit for troubleshooting and managing your network, with ping, port scanning, DNS lookup, traceroute, Wake-on-LAN, and speed testing - all in a fast, native iOS app designed with Swift UI.

posts.name: BaseBackups
posts.tagline: Scheduled off-site backups for Supabase database
posts.description: Supabase Free has no backups at all. Pro keeps them inside the project they are meant to protect, so losing the project loses the backups with it. BaseBackups runs a real pg_dump on your schedule and stores it somewhere else - our storage or a bucket you own. Optional zero-knowledge encryption with a passphrase we never receive. Restore in one click from the browser. Setup in less than a minute. Free forever for one project, backed up daily.

posts.name: NULX
posts.tagline: Video you own. Costs you can predict.
posts.description: NULX is an early-access video service for courses, membership businesses, and internal teams who want control of their video library and a predictable monthly cost before committing. Public signup opens September 1.

posts.name: CardOwners.com
posts.tagline: Fast trading card price database
posts.description: Card lists with live market prices for every trading card set. Sort by price and rarity, find the top chase cards, and see what your cards are worth.

posts.name: Demoloop
posts.tagline: Every visitor gets a live product demo. No call booked.
posts.description: Demoloop puts a "See it live" button on your site. Visitors talk (or type) with an AI guide that drives your real product in an isolated sandbox, answers only from your approved knowledge, and sends your team the transcript, qualification, and objections.
